question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant encountered when moving toward Virginia B Ball Center for Creative Inquiry, Muncie, IN from Daubenspeck Nature Reserve, Indianapolis, IN?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.185252 39.917104)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.426059 40.197552)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.185252 39.917104)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.185252 39.917104)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Virginia B Ball Center for Creative Inquiry, Muncie, IN

poi.poi_name: Virginia B Ball Center for Creative Inquiry
